Vanuatu ( English: / ˌ v ɑː n u ˈ ɑː t uː / ⓘ VAH -noo- AH -too or / v æ n ˈ w ɑː t uː / van- WAH -too ; Bislama and French pronunciation [vanuatu] ), officially the Republic of Vanuatu (French: République de Vanuatu ; Bislama : Ripablik blong Vanuatu ), is an archipelagic country in Melanesia located in the South Pacific Ocean. The archipelago , which is of volcanic origin, is 1,750 km (1,090 mi) east of northern Australia, 540 km (340 mi) northeast of New Caledonia , east of New Guinea , southeast of Solomon Islands , and west of Fiji .
